scope: Simpler menus with letter shortcuts, speech that stops when you talk, a hints setting, Favorite apps in any order, and a new hands-on tutorial.

topics.title: A new hands-on tutorial
details: The old tutorial is gone. The new one asks you to press a key or say a command.
It checks what you did and tells you if it was right.
If you miss twice, it offers to show you or to skip.
It has lessons for every app on the main menu.
Nothing in the tutorial sends mail, changes files or changes settings.
Say Tutorial or press Control+T to start. It remembers where you stopped.

topics.title: Hints and help messages
details: A new choice in Verbosity options turns tips on or off.
Say Hints off or Hints on from any screen.
With hints off, you hear what happened, without the extra tips.
Questions, how to answer them, and steps to fix a problem are always said.

topics.title: Web tools on the main menu
details: Web tools has the web browser and its tools. These are favorites, history, downloads and Chrome setup.
Saying Web browser still opens it from anywhere.

topics.title: Favorite apps in any order
details: In Options, My menu is now called Favorite apps.
It is one list. Press Space to pick or unpick an app.
Press Control+Up or Control+Down to move an app. Control+F1 uses your order.
You can also say select, unselect, move up, move down, move to top or move to bottom.
The apps you picked before stay picked.

topics.title: Menus
details: The main menu now says just the first item, like File manager (F), 1 of 10.
Every menu now opens on its first item and says its letter.
Alt menus now use letters. Press Alt, then the group's letter, then the item's letter.
The old number paths, like Alt 2 4, are gone.
The same action has the same letter in every app.
Alt menu groups have clearer names, such as Message, Edit, Go to, View and Tools.
In the word processor menu, the letter you heard now runs that item.

topics.title: Speech stops when you talk
details: Companion now goes quiet as soon as you start a command or start to dictate.
This works the same on every screen.
Stop talking and Resume work as before.
Noise in the room does not cut Companion off.

topics.title: Keys in text boxes
details: In YouTube, Alt+O no longer types into the search box and searches.
Alt+O, F1 and Control+F1 never type their words into a name or answer box.
Alt+F4 now closes the window from every screen.

topics.title: Tab key
details: Tab no longer stops on buttons like Options when you do not need them.
In Options, Tab moves between the settings, OK and Cancel.

topics.title: Other fixes
details: Go to website example dot com now opens example dot com.
Low and Medium verbosity no longer cut off the steps to fix a problem.
Help with my menu now opens the right topic.
The browser no longer talks over itself when it closes.
